title: fix(app-shell): one neutral sentence for a refused activity read on Home and the bell
body:
Fixes #12859
Clause-②: no.

## What changed

A refused `sys_activity` read (the shared feed's `refused: true`, set by `isRefusedFeedRead` since objectui#12843) now shows one neutral sentence on both surfaces that have no record:

- **Home's activity card** (`HomeActivity` in `console/home/HomeRail.tsx`) read the record panel's `detail.activityAccessDenied` ("You don't have permission to view activity on this record."). It now reads the new `layout.activityFeed.accessDenied` ("You don't have permission to view activity.").
- **The header bell's Activity tab** (`InboxPopover`) drew `errors.unknown` ("An unexpected error occurred.") for every error, the 403 included. For `refused === true` it now draws the same new key with Home's lock icon (`data-testid="inbox-activity-access-denied"`). Every other failure keeps `errors.unknown` on both surfaces.
- The new key is in all ten `packages/i18n` packs, right after `layout.activityFeed.empty`, away from the `workspace.*` / `organizations.*` / `cloudOnboarding.*` regions. `detail.activityAccessDenied` is unchanged and stays the record panel's.
- `isRefusedFeedRead` stays the one classifier. The feed hook (`sharedUserFeeds.ts`) is not touched.

Mechanism check (A1, measured): the bell reads the same shared reading. `AppHeader` passes `useSharedActivityFeed()` as `activity`, and so does `global:notifications` (`global-notifications-renderer.tsx`). `ActivityFeedReading.refused` was already on the prop, so the bell only had to read it.

## Pins

- `layout/__tests__/InboxPopover.refusedActivity-12859.test.tsx` (new): real `InboxPopover`, real `HomeActivity` and the real record panel, under the real catalogue in `en` and `zh-CN`. Refused: the bell shows the neutral sentence with a lock; Home shows the same text; the record panel beside them shows a different sentence. CONTROL: an error that is not a refusal shows the generic copy on both.
- `layout/__tests__/AppHeader.inboxVariant.test.tsx`: the real path through the hook. A 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` from the adapter used to be pinned as "An unexpected error occurred." on the bell. It now reads the neutral sentence. A new CONTROL: a 500 keeps the generic copy and no access-denied node.
- `console/home/__tests__/HomeActivity.refusedRead-12843.test.tsx`: a 403 on Home now reads the neutral sentence, not "this record". CONTROL: the record panel rendered beside it still reads "You don't have permission to view activity on this record.". The key-echo cell now expects `layout.activityFeed.accessDenied`.

**Ablation (one run, committed fix at `17388be9be`):** `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the bell's `activity.status === 'error' && activity.refused ? (` with `... && false ? (`. Anchor count went 1 to 0, blob `a14325a16be7` to `cd3ff0cb99f0`. Result: 5 cells failed, 39 passed. The failures were the AppHeader 403 cell and the two refused cells in each language. All CONTROL cells stayed green. Restore: blob after restore `a14325a16be7` equals the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. A trap was armed on EXIT INT TERM.

## Gates (all on `17388be9be`)

- Type-check: closure build `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`, then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; `--listFilesOnly` lists the new test). Lock verdict: command-exit 0.
- vitest: the three test files, 49/49. `packages/i18n/` in full, 83 files: 1325 passed, 13 skipped.
- **`packages/app-shell/` in full: NOT MEASURED.** The tree has 1540 test files. At `--maxWorkers=1` the run produced no verdict in about 70 minutes, so I stopped it. Declared narrowing (lock verdict command-exit 0), 217 files and 1887 tests passed: `packages/app-shell/src/layout/`, `src/console/home/`, `src/hooks/__tests__/`, `src/__tests__/` (it holds the i18n and product-neutral ratchets), `RecordDetailView.feedRefusal-11195`, `AppContent.pseudoRouteSegments`, `global-page-blocks.render`, and `apps/console` `approvalsInboxComponentRef`. These are every test outside the first two directories that names `InboxPopover`, `HomeRail` or `HomeActivity` in a `git grep`. The rest of the package is left to CI.
- Lint, narrowed: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the 15 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files gave 15 files, 0 errors and 15 warnings. Every warning is on a line this diff did not touch (`no-explicit-any` and `no-unused-vars` in the AppHeader test stubs, plus one in HomeRail). The config sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot change the verdict on any file it did not touch.
- Battery, all exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `i18n-dead-keys`, `control-bytes`, plus `node scripts/check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs` and `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`.

Changeset: `.changeset/12859-activity-refused-copy.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`, patch).

## Acceptance notes

- The file surface named `HomeRail.tsx`, `InboxPopover.tsx`, the packs and "tests beside". Two existing test files changed with it: `AppHeader.inboxVariant.test.tsx`, because it pinned the old generic copy for the bell's 403 and that pin had to flip, and `HomeActivity.refusedRead-12843.test.tsx`, because it pinned Home equal to the record sentence.
